U.S. DIESEL HITS RECORD $6.51 A GALLON

U.S. diesel prices have surged to a record $6.51 a gallon, according to AAA.

Prices are being driven higher by prolonged disruptions to Middle East energy flows and Russian refineries, tightening global fuel supplies ahead of winter.
